name: Lac Operon Regulation (Publication Figure - v2)
description: Balanced complexity for Nature/Science - compact layout with sufficient detail
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    %% Environmental Inputs
    A[Lactose in Environment] --> B{Lactose Available?}
    B -->|Yes| C[Lactose Uptake]
    B -->|No| END1[❌ Pathway OFF]
    
    C --> D[Intracellular Lactose]
    D --> E[β-Gal Basal Activity]
    E --> F[Allolactose Formation]
    
    %% NOT Gate 1: LacI Repressor System
    F --> G[\LacI Inactivation/]
    H[Default: LacI Active] -->|Binds| I[Operator O1]
    G -->|Releases| I
    I --> J{Operator Free?}
    J -->|Yes| K[Promoter Accessible]
    J -->|No| END2[❌ Blocked]
    
    %% Glucose Sensing Branch
    L[Glucose Level] --> M{Glucose High?}
    M -->|Yes| N[\CAP Inactive/]
    M -->|No| O[Low Glucose Signal]
    
    %% Energy Sensing Branch  
    P[ATP/AMP Ratio] --> Q{Energy Low?}
    Q -->|Yes| R[Adenylyl Cyclase Active]
    Q -->|No| END3[❌ No cAMP]
    
    %% OR Gate: Glucose OR Energy
    O --> S[cAMP Production]
    R --> S
    
    S --> T[cAMP Accumulation]
    T --> U{{CAP-cAMP Complex}}
    
    %% AND Gate 1: Operator + CAP
    K --> V{{Transcription Complex Assembly}}
    U --> V
    V -->|Both Present| W[RNA Polymerase Recruitment]
    
    %% AND Gate 2: RNAP + Sigma Factor
    W --> X{{Transcription Initiation}}
    Y[Sigma-70 Factor] --> X
    
    X --> Z[Polycistronic mRNA]
    
    %% Gene Expression
    Z --> AA[lacZ Translation]
    Z --> AB[lacY Translation]
    Z --> AC[lacA Translation]
    
    AA --> AD[β-Galactosidase]
    AB --> AE[Permease]
    AC --> AF[Transacetylase]
    
    %% Positive Feedback
    AD -.Enhanced uptake.-> C
    AE -.Enhanced uptake.-> C
    
    %% Final Output
    AD --> AG((Lactose → Glucose + Galactose))
    AE --> AG
    AF --> AG

logicalFormulaExpanded: ((Lactose → Allolactose) ∧ (Allolactose → ¬LacI_Active) ∧ (¬Glucose ∨ LowEnergy → cAMP) ∧ (cAMP → CAP_Active)) → (OperatorFree ∧ CAP_Active) → StrongTranscription → LactoseMetabolism
caption: Figure 1: Lac Operon Regulation as a Computational Program. Environmental inputs (green) include lactose availability, glucose levels, and energy status. The system processes these through multiple logic gates: OR gates (yellow diamonds) for flexible sensing, AND gates (purple hexagons) for signal integration, and NOT gates (red trapezoids) for repression control. Processing steps (blue) lead to enzyme production (amber) and lactose metabolism (black). Positive feedback loops (dashed) enhance system responsiveness. The logical formula: (Lactose ∧ ¬Glucose ∧ LowEnergy) → LactoseMetabolism demonstrates computable Boolean logic in gene regulation. This 32-node representation balances detail with readability for publication scale.
keyInsights: 3 OR gates: Lactose, Glucose/Energy sensing, Operator status
2 AND gates: Transcription complex assembly, Initiation complex
2 NOT gates: LacI repressor, CAP inactivation
32 nodes: Dense but readable at 1.5-column width
